activity.notes: Jalal-ud-Din Muhammad Akbar, commonly known as Akbar the Great, ruled the Mughal Empire from 1556 to 1605. The record represents his sovereign reign at year granularity.

sources.title: Numismatics and Epigraphy Collection — National Museum, New Delhi
sources.citation_text: The National Museum, New Delhi describes Jalal-ud-Din Akbar as popularly known as Akbar the Great and dates his reign to 1556–1605 CE.

sources.title: The Art of the Mughals before 1600 — The Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum of Art identifies Akbar's Mughal reign as 1556–1605 and credits him with consolidating and expanding the Mughal Empire.
